1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q = w^H·Z·w with respect to the corresponding precoder w, where the quadratic form is based on a transmission line impedance of a transmission line between a signal source and the antenna array, __and wherein Z comprises an impedance matrix that includes at least the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__; receiving a signal from the signal source; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w__ is also based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array __that is computed as a function of the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__.

3. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w__ is also based on a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, __wherein the matching network affects the impedance matrix Z used in the quadratic form__.

4. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w__ is also based on an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line, __wherein these parameters are incorporated into the impedance matrix Z__.

5. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied, __wherein the scaling factor is computed as 1/√(w^H·Z·w) where Z is the impedance matrix based on the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__.

6. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 5, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w, wherein the normalized precoder w_norm = w/√(w^H·Z·w)__.

7. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 5, further comprising transmitting a scaling factor used for the scaling, __wherein the scaling factor is transmitted to a receiver to enable proper channel estimation and demodulation of the precoded signal__.

8. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix T such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power, __wherein T is computed such that for each transformed precoder w'_i = T·w_i, the quadratic form w'_i^H·Z·w'_i is equal for all i__.

9. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 8, wherein the transformation matrix is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array, __wherein the impedance matrix Z is computed as Z = Z_source + Z_line + Z_antenna, where Z_line is a function of transmission line length and transmission line impedance__.

10. (Original) The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders.

11. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array, __wherein equal energy is defined as each transformed precoder w'_i satisfying w'_i^H·Z·w'_i = constant for all i, where Z is the impedance matrix that includes transmission line impedance__.

12. (Original) The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation.

13. (Original) The method according to claim 12, further comprising: receiving a precoded signal including reference symbols; estimating channels for the reference symbols; estimating a channel for the data symbols by taking an inner product of a conjugate of a data symbol precoder and the reference symbol channel estimates; and demodulating received data symbols based on the estimated channel.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: an antenna array; a transceiver coupled to the antenna array; a signal source coupled to the transceiver; a transmission line coupled between the signal source and the antenna array, the transmission line having a transmission line impedance; a memory to store a codebook including a plurality of precoders; and a controller coupled to the transceiver and the memory, the controller configured to: receive a plurality of precoders from the codebook, transform each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q = w^H·Z·w with respect to the corresponding precoder w, where the quadratic form is based on the transmission line impedance, __and wherein Z comprises an impedance matrix that includes at least the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__, receive a signal from the signal source, and apply a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel, wherein the transceiver transmits the precoded signal.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w__ is also based on at least one selected from an impedance matrix of the antenna array __computed as a function of transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__, a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array __that affects the impedance matrix Z__, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line __wherein these parameters are incorporated into the impedance matrix Z__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied, __wherein the scaling factor is computed as 1/√(w^H·Z·w) where Z is the impedance matrix based on the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance__.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 16, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form __Q = w^H·Z·w, wherein the normalized precoder w_norm = w/√(w^H·Z·w)__.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix T such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power, __wherein T is computed such that for each transformed precoder w'_i = T·w_i, the quadratic form w'_i^H·Z·w'_i is equal for all i__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 18, wherein the transformation matrix is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array, __wherein the impedance matrix Z is computed as Z = Z_source + Z_line + Z_antenna, where Z_line is a function of transmission line length and transmission line impedance__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array, __wherein equal energy is defined as each transformed precoder w'_i satisfying w'_i^H·Z·w'_i = constant for all i, where Z is the impedance matrix that includes transmission line impedance__.
